* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “USED: Activate 1 Force (2 if a Lars on table). LOST: During battle at a farm, after battle destiny is drawn, place a 'crop' out of play to make attrition against you = 0.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Beru Stew (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) changed “battle destiny is” to “battle destinies are”. PC-E1 text: “USED: Activate 1 Force (2 if a Lars on table). OR During battle at a farm, add the destiny number of your device on this farm to your total power. LOST: During battle at a farm, after battle destinies are drawn, place a 'crop' out of play to make attrition against you = 0.”<ref name="cl-1210_147-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
